basic_details.job_title: SRES-DID Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 District Programme Assistant, Block Programme Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two contractual posts under Swachh Bharat Mission-Grameen (SBM-G) in South Garo Hills District, Meghalaya, are open to eligible residents of Meghalaya: one District Programme Assistant (DPA) and one Block Programme Assistant (BPA). Applications go to the Office of the District Rural Development Agency (DRDA), South Garo Hills District, Baghmara, and must be submitted on or before 30 November 2026; applications received after that date will not be entertained. The advertisement is issued by the State Rural Employment Society - District Implementing Division (SRES-DID), Community & Rural Develop

content_sections.heading: SRES-DID South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: State Rural Employment Society - District Implementing Division (SRES-DID), South Garo Hills District, Meghalaya
District Programme Assistant (DPA); Block Programme Assistant (BPA)
₹20,000/- per month (DPA); ₹15,000/- per month (BPA) – starting fixed salary
DPMU, South Garo Hills District (DPA); Siju C&RD Block (BPA)
Application to the Office of the DRDA, South Garo Hills District, Baghmara
30 November 2026 (on or before; late applications not entertained)

content_sections.heading: About SRES-DID South Garo Hills
content_sections.text: The State Rural Employment Society - District Implementing Division (SRES-DID) of South Garo Hills District describes itself as a nodal agency for the implementation of MGNREGA, PMAY-G, RGSA, PMAAGY, PMAGY and other schemes, under the Community & Rural Development Department, Government of Meghalaya. Its office is at Baghmara, South Garo Hills District, Meghalaya – 794102. These two posts are for Swachh Bharat Mission-Grameen (SBM-G) in the district: the DPA works under the District Project Management Unit (DPMU) and the BPA is for Siju C&RD Block.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in standard form to: Office of the District Rural Development Agency (DRDA), South Garo Hills District, Baghmara. The organisation's letterhead gives its location as South Garo Hills District, Meghalaya, Baghmara – 794102.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Both posts carry word for word the same eligibility conditions: Residence: eligible residents of Meghalaya. Minimum qualification: Graduate in any discipline. Experience: Relevant experience preferred. Upper age limit: 35 years. The notice prints no date for counting age and no age relaxation. The engagement is on a contractual basis for a period of one (1) year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of the programme. The salary is described as a starting fixed salary; the notice names no allowances. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

rows.place_of_posting: District Project Management Unit (DPMU), South Garo Hills District

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application in standard form must be accompanied by: Self-attested photocopy of Bio-data and testimonials Self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates Self-attested photocopies of experience certificates (if any) One (1) recent passport-size photograph Contact details

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the DPA and BPA posts takes place in two stages: Screening Test and/or Computer Skill Test – eligible candidates shall be required to appear for a Screening Test and/or Computer Skill Test, as applicable, for the respective posts. The date and venue of the tests shall be notified separately. Personal Interview – shortlisted candidates will subsequently be called for Personal Interview. No TA/DA will be entertained for candidates appearing for the Screening Test, Computer Skill Test and Personal Interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement shall be purely contractual and shall not confer any right to claim regular appointment or absorption against any permanent post under the Government. The one-year contract is extendable only subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of the programme. Applications received after 30 November 2026 will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SRES-DID South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 01 District Programme Assistant (DPA) and 01 Block Programme Assistant (BPA) under SBM-G.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 30 November 2026; applications received after that date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the DPA and BPA posts?
faq.answer: Both posts require a Graduate in any discipline, and relevant experience is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for both the DPA and BPA posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the DPA and BPA posts?
faq.answer: The starting fixed salary is ₹20,000/- per month for the District Programme Assistant and ₹15,000/- per month for the Block Programme Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit an application in standard form with self-attested copies of Bio-data and testimonials, educational and experience certificates (if any), one passport-size photograph and contact details to the Office of the DRDA, South Garo Hills District, Baghmara.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates appear for a Screening Test and/or Computer Skill Test, as applicable, and shortlisted candidates are then called for a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Only eligible residents of Meghalaya who meet the qualification and age conditions can apply.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is contractual for one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of the programme, and confers no right to regular appointment or absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the test and interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be entertained for the Screening Test, Computer Skill Test and Personal Interview.
